record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, untie history and candidate item embeddings while retaining their current dimensions and unit normalization. Initialize the candidate table as an exact copy of the history table, then train both jointly within each category's single GRU4Rec model. Separate context and target roles may improve compatibility without relaxing normalization, which previously regressed. Preserve features, history policy, GRU topology, dot-product scoring, loss and optimizer; update checkpoint loading and the predictor writer.

category_rationales.rationale: Untie history and candidate embeddings across all four datasets while retaining their dimensions, unit normalization and zero padding. Copy the initialized history table without consuming additional random draws, then train both tables jointly within each category's single GRU4Rec model. Preserve GRU topology, readout, scoring, loss and optimizer; synchronize checkpoint metadata and predictor validation.
